primitives.note: Q's initial missile hit and E's laser are fixed-damage instances dealt on cast/after travel time, recastable on cooldown against the stationary dummy.
Discharge arms Viktor's next basic attack to deal separate modified magic damage (base + AD + AP) instead of a normal auto-attack.
Arcane Storm has a distinct initial burst followed by a separately-timed ticking storm phase; it can be recast to redirect the storm, which has no effect against a single stationary target.
After the initial burst, the singularity ticks roughly once per second on the dummy for the storm's duration, dealing the subsequent-burst damage per tick.
Mana costs and cooldowns (especially R's 80-120s cooldown, castable at most once in a 15s window) limit how many times each ability is recast during the fight.

needsBespoke.why: Viktor's damage-relevant kit reduces to standard shapes: Q is a plain-cast missile plus a separately-instanced empowered next attack (Discharge), E is a plain-cast laser, and R is an initial-burst-plus-DoT recastable ability. W deals no damage and its crowd control has no effect on a dummy that doesn't move or fight back, so it's outside the damage fight entirely. The Glorious Evolution augment system requires 100 Hex Fragments from kills/takedowns, which are unreachable in a 15s single-target dummy fight, so augmented ability variants never activate and need no bespoke logic.

unsettled.question: Over Arcane Storm's 6.5s base duration at a 1s tick cadence, how many total damage instances (initial burst + subsequent ticks) does it actually deal?
options: 6 total instances: bin's ViktorR.MaxTicks = 6 is the count of subsequent-tick instances, giving initial + 5 subsequent ticks (6 total hits)
7 total instances: wiki explicitly states 'The base duration allows for 7 strikes (including the initial one)', i.e. initial + 6 subsequent ticks
quotes: The base duration allows for 7 strikes (including the initial one).

unsettled.question: Is Discharge granted immediately when Q is cast, or only once the Q missile actually lands on the target?
options: Discharge (and the shield) apply on cast, unconditional on the missile hitting
Discharge is only granted after the missile connects with the target (consistent with the Turbocharge augment's 'After the device hits' language for its bonus effects)

unsettled.question: Does casting Q reset/advance Viktor's basic attack timer, or does the Discharge-empowered attack simply wait for the next naturally scheduled auto-attack?
options: No attack-timer reset; Discharge just marks whichever auto-attack comes next on the existing swing timer
Casting Q also functions as an attack reset, letting Viktor immediately follow up with the empowered attack without losing swing-timer progress

proposal: Open by casting Q (Siphon Power) on the dummy for its initial magic missile damage, which also grants Discharge.
Immediately follow with a basic attack to consume Discharge for its separate modified magic damage before it can expire.
Cast E (Hextech Ray) through the dummy for its laser damage; it has no cast time, so weave it freely between attacks and other casts.

Cast R (Arcane Storm) on the dummy for its initial burst damage, then let the singularity tick on the dummy roughly once per second for the remainder of its ~6.5s duration; a recast to redirect it is unnecessary since there is only one stationary target.

For the rest of the 15s window, recast Q and E on cooldown, always pairing each Q with a following basic attack to use Discharge, and keep auto-attacking between casts to maximize on-hit and empowered-attack uptime.
Never cast W: it deals no damage, and its slow/stun has no effect on a stationary dummy that does not move or fight back.
R will not come off cooldown again inside the 15s window (80-120s cooldown, post-effect start), so it is cast exactly once.
questions: Does Q's cast reset or otherwise interact with Viktor's basic-attack swing timer, and should the auto-attack that consumes Discharge be thrown just before or just after the Q cast for maximum uptime?

Given R's long cooldown means it fires at most once regardless of sequencing, does opening the fight with R (to front-load its 6.5s DoT before the fight ends) beat opening with Q/E to build early Discharge/attack-speed uptime?
Should E be cast before or after Q and the first auto-attack, given its instant cast time but nonzero travel delay before the laser actually connects with the dummy?
